summary: Lion Copper Corp., a British Columbia-incorporated, Nevada-focused copper developer listed on Nasdaq (LCU) and the Canadian Securities Exchange, filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026 reporting that its common shares commenced trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol LCU effective October 19, 2026, a US listing uplift while retaining its CSE listing. The company also retained Renmark Financial Communications USA for investor relations at up to US$10,000 monthly from November 15, 2026 through June 15, 2027, and monthly thereafter. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. This is a routine listing and IR-vendor event, not a special situation; watch liquidity migration and promotion-driven volume.
